newsitem.title: USA: First United to not close Apollo offering. [CORRECTED 22:49 GMT]
newsitem.headline: First United to not close Apollo offering. [CORRECTED 22:49 GMT]

text.p: First United Equities Corp said on Thursday it will not close its latest offering of 1.2 million Apollo BioPharmaceutics Inc units.
First United said that, due to market conditions, it had no option but to exercise its termination rights pursuant to the underwriting agreement.
First United said it will conduct business as usual and does not expect the failure to close the Apollo transaction will in any way affect future financing.

Apollo said on Wednesday (corrects day) it suspended trading of its common stock and common stock warrants and would not effect a closing of its initial public offering due to certain unresolved issues with its underwriters.
